analysis: Lead-Time Analysis (SIMULATED proof-of-concept - NOT real longitudinal data)
method: Each 'week' is an independent random sample of Normal/Depression texts drawn from the same dataset. The analysis measures how reliably the model separates Normal vs Depression. 'weeks_remaining' is a framing device to express intervention lead-time, not a measured outcome. No students were tracked over real time.
conclusion: In simulation, the model separates Normal vs Depression at ~89-91% at every time point. Stable early detection implies that the earlier distress language appears in student writing, the larger the intervention window (up to ~14 weeks). This is a capability demonstration, not validated longitudinal evidence.
